entries.title: Ammo hit
entries.effect: Destroyed, unless the card shows CASE (1 extra damage instead) or ENE / CASEII (no effect).

entries.title: Engine hit
entries.effect: Gains 1 heat in the End Phase of any turn it fires. A second engine hit destroys it.

entries.title: Weapon hit
entries.effect: All damage values (S/M/L) drop by 1 (floor 0). If they are all 0 already, take 1 damage instead.

entries.title: MP hit
entries.effect: Halve MV and TMM, rounding down, at least −2″ and −1 TMM. Each further MP hit halves again. At 0″ it is immobile.

entries.title: Weapon hit
entries.effect: All damage values (S/M/L) drop by 1 (floor 0). If they are all 0 already, take 1 damage instead.

entries.title: Engine hit
entries.effect: Gains 1 heat in the End Phase of any turn it fires. A second engine hit destroys it.

entries.title: Destroyed
entries.effect: Remove it at the end of the turn.
